title: Combined ultrafast holographic Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy microscopy for the examination of head and neck tumor tissue samples
summary: The goal of TROPHY is to develop a microscope that combines the properties of several innovative light-imaging techniques to enable simultaneous classical tissue analysis (histopathology) and chemical analysis. The microscope will combine: Infrared laser, digital holography and Fourier transform infrared spectrometry.
conditions: patients with Head and Neck carcinoma

interventions.name:
N=100
Head and neck tumor specimens for tissue sections

N= 30
Samples from head and neck tumors for cell culture and tumor-slice culture experiments

N = 30
Ex vivo observation with a demonstrator of the TROPHY microscope

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Patients who have already undergone surgery for a head and neck tumor and who have written informed consent for the use of residual material, in which residual tumor tissue has been accrued and preserved
or
- Patients undergoing surgery for a head and neck tumor and who have accrued residual tumor tissue
or
- There is a signed informed consent from the patient for participation in the TROPHY study.
Exclusion criteria:
non
